metrics.note: Model: gpt-6-sol through the Codex CLI signed in with ChatGPT (reasoning effort low). Token counts are estimates of the Copilot's own prompts; Codex adds about 21,000 tokens of its own instructions to every call. Cost is zero because calls are billed to the ChatGPT plan.

results.sql: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(balance_due), 0) AS total_piutang_belum_dibayar FROM copilot.invoices WHERE direction = 'receivable' AND NOT status IN ('DRAFT', 'CANCELLED', 'VOID') AND balance_due > 0 LIMIT 200

SELECT customer_name, SUM(balance_due) AS total_piutang_belum_dibayar FROM copilot.invoices WHERE direction = 'receivable' AND balance_due > 0 AND NOT status IN ('DRAFT', 'PO_DRAFT', 'CANCELLED', 'REJECTED', 'VOID') GROUP BY customer_id, customer_name ORDER BY total_piutang_belum_dibayar DESC LIMIT 5

SELECT number, balance_due FROM copilot.invoices WHERE direction = 'receivable' AND due_date >= CURRENT_DATE AND due_date < CURRENT_DATE + 7 AND balance_due > 0 AND NOT status IN ('DRAFT', 'PO_DRAFT', 'CANCELLED', 'REJECTED', 'VOID') ORDER BY due_date, number LIMIT 200
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(balance_due), 0) AS total_supplier_payables_idr FROM copilot.invoices WHERE direction = 'payable' AND NOT status IN ('DRAFT', 'CANCELLED', 'VOID') LIMIT 200

SELECT number, supplier_name, CURRENT_DATE - due_date AS days_overdue FROM copilot.invoices WHERE direction = 'payable' AND due_date < CURRENT_DATE AND balance_due > 0 AND NOT status IN ('DRAFT', 'CANCELLED', 'VOID') ORDER BY days_overdue DESC, number LIMIT 200

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(balance_due), 0) AS overdue_receivables_idr FROM copilot.invoices WHERE direction = 'receivable' AND due_date < CURRENT_DATE AND balance_due > 0 AND NOT status IN ('DRAFT', 'PO_DRAFT', 'CANCELLED', 'REJECTED', 'VOID') LIMIT 200

SELECT customer_name, SUM(balance_due) AS overdue_amount_idr FROM copilot.invoices WHERE direction = 'receivable' AND due_date < CURRENT_DATE AND balance_due > 0 AND NOT status IN ('DRAFT', 'PO_DRAFT', 'CANCELLED', 'REJECTED', 'VOID') GROUP BY customer_id, customer_name ORDER BY overdue_amount_idr DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) AS jumlah_faktur_penjualan_overdue FROM copilot.invoices WHERE direction = 'receivable' AND status = 'OVERDUE' LIMIT 200

SELECT AVG(due_date - issue_date) AS average_days_to_due FROM copilot.invoices WHERE direction = 'receivable' AND NOT status IN ('DRAFT', 'CANCELLED', 'REJECTED', 'VOID') AND issue_date IS NOT NULL AND due_date IS NOT NULL LIMIT 200
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) AS total_pembayaran_diterima_idr FROM copilot.payments WHERE direction = 'received' AND payment_date >= CURRENT_DATE - 30 LIMIT 200
SELECT method, COUNT(*) AS payment_count, SUM(amount) AS total_received_idr FROM copilot.payments WHERE direction = 'received' GROUP BY method ORDER BY total_received_idr DESC LIMIT 200

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(p.amount), 0) AS total_paid_to_suppliers_idr FROM copilot.payments AS p JOIN copilot.invoices AS i ON p.invoice_id = i.id WHERE p.direction = 'paid' AND i.direction = 'payable' AND p.payment_date >= CURRENT_DATE - 60 AND NOT i.status IN ('DRAFT', 'CANCELLED', 'VOID') LIMIT 200

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total), 0) AS total_penjualan_termasuk_pajak FROM copilot.sales_orders WHERE order_date >= CURRENT_DATE - 30 AND order_date <= CURRENT_DATE AND NOT status IN ('DRAFT', 'PO_DRAFT', 'CANCELLED', 'REJECTED', 'VOID') LIMIT 200

SELECT TO_CHAR(m.month_start, 'YYYY-MM') AS month, COALESCE(SUM(so.total), 0) AS total_sales_idr FROM GENERATE_SERIES(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '5 MONTHS', DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CURRENT_DATE), INTERVAL '1 MONTH') AS m(month_start) LEFT JOIN copilot.sales_orders AS so ON so.order_date >= m.month_start AND so.order_date < m.month_start + INTERVAL '1 MONTH' AND NOT so.status IN ('DRAFT', 'PO_DRAFT', 'CANCELLED', 'REJECTED', 'VOID') GROUP BY m.month_start ORDER BY m.month_start LIMIT 200

SELECT customer_name, SUM(total) AS sales_including_tax FROM copilot.sales_orders WHERE NOT status IN ('DRAFT', 'PO_DRAFT', 'CANCELLED', 'REJECTED', 'VOID') GROUP BY customer_id, customer_name ORDER BY sales_including_tax DESC LIMIT 3

SELECT soi.product_name, SUM(soi.line_total) AS nilai_penjualan_sebelum_pajak FROM copilot.sales_order_items AS soi JOIN copilot.sales_orders AS so ON so.id = soi.sales_order_id WHERE so.order_date >= CURRENT_DATE - 90 AND NOT so.status IN ('DRAFT', 'CANCELLED') GROUP BY soi.product_id, soi.product_name ORDER BY nilai_penjualan_sebelum_pajak DESC LIMIT 5
SELECT COUNT(*) AS sales_order_count FROM copilot.sales_orders WHERE status IN ('CONFIRMED', 'IN_PROGRESS') LIMIT 200

SELECT AVG(total) AS average_order_total_idr FROM copilot.sales_orders WHERE order_date >= CAST(DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', CURRENT_DATE) AS DATE) AND order_date < CAST((DATE_TRUNC('YEAR', CURRENT_DATE) + INTERVAL '1 YEAR') AS DATE) AND NOT status IN ('DRAFT', 'CANCELLED') LIMIT 200

SELECT p.category, SUM(soi.line_total) AS sales_before_tax_idr FROM copilot.sales_order_items AS soi JOIN copilot.sales_orders AS so ON so.id = soi.sales_order_id JOIN copilot.products AS p ON p.id = soi.product_id WHERE NOT so.status IN ('DRAFT', 'CANCELLED') GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY sales_before_tax_idr DESC LIMIT 200

SELECT code, name, last_order_date FROM copilot.customers WHERE is_active = TRUE AND (last_order_date < CURRENT_DATE - 60 OR last_order_date IS NULL) ORDER BY last_order_date NULLS FIRST, name LIMIT 200
SELECT code, name, credit_status FROM copilot.customers WHERE credit_status IN ('HOLD', 'WATCH') ORDER BY credit_status, name LIMIT 200

SELECT c.code, c.name, c.credit_limit, SUM(i.balance_due) AS unpaid_amount FROM copilot.customers AS c JOIN copilot.invoices AS i ON i.customer_id = c.id WHERE i.direction = 'receivable' AND NOT i.status IN ('DRAFT', 'CANCELLED', 'VOID') AND i.balance_due > 0 AND c.credit_limit > 0 GROUP BY c.id, c.code, c.name, c.credit_limit HAVING SUM(i.balance_due) > c.credit_limit / 2 ORDER BY unpaid_amount DESC LIMIT 200
SELECT COUNT(*) AS active_government_customers FROM copilot.customers WHERE is_active = TRUE AND customer_type = 'GOVERNMENT' LIMIT 200
SELECT code, name, on_time_rate_pct FROM copilot.suppliers WHERE on_time_rate_pct < 85 ORDER BY on_time_rate_pct ASC LIMIT 200
SELECT COUNT(*) AS purchase_orders_waiting_for_delivery FROM copilot.purchase_orders WHERE status IN ('ORDERED', 'VENDOR_CONFIRMED', 'SHIPPED') LIMIT 200

SELECT supplier_name, SUM(net_amount) AS total_purchased_idr FROM copilot.purchase_orders WHERE order_date >= CURRENT_DATE - 90 AND NOT status IN ('PO_DRAFT', 'CANCELLED', 'REJECTED') GROUP BY supplier_name ORDER BY total_purchased_idr DESC LIMIT 1

SELECT CAST(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', order_date) AS DATE) AS month, SUM(amount_before_tax) AS total_pembelian_sebelum_pajak FROM copilot.purchase_orders WHERE order_date >= DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CURRENT_DATE) - INTERVAL '2 MONTHS' AND order_date < DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CURRENT_DATE) + INTERVAL '1 MONTH' AND NOT status IN ('PO_DRAFT', 'CANCELLED', 'REJECTED', 'VOID') GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 200

SELECT po.number AS po_number, poi.product_name, poi.quantity AS ordered_qty, poi.received_qty FROM copilot.purchase_order_items AS poi JOIN copilot.purchase_orders AS po ON po.id = poi.purchase_order_id WHERE poi.received_qty > 0 AND poi.received_qty < poi.quantity AND NOT po.status IN ('PO_DRAFT', 'CANCELLED', 'REJECTED') ORDER BY po.number, poi.product_name LIMIT 200

SELECT product_code, product_name, SUM(available_qty) AS total_available_qty, MAX(reorder_level) AS reorder_level FROM copilot.stock GROUP BY product_id, product_code, product_name HAVING SUM(available_qty) < MAX(reorder_level) ORDER BY total_available_qty ASC, product_name LIMIT 200
SELECT warehouse_name, SUM(quantity) AS total_quantity FROM copilot.stock WHERE warehouse_name = 'Gudang Barang Jadi Jakarta' GROUP BY warehouse_name LIMIT 200
SELECT COALESCE(SUM(s.quantity * p.cost_price), 0) AS stock_value_idr FROM copilot.stock AS s JOIN copilot.products AS p ON p.id = s.product_id LIMIT 200

SELECT product_code, product_name, unit, SUM(available_qty) AS total_available_qty FROM copilot.stock WHERE product_name ILIKE '%Katun Combed 30s%' AND unit = 'meter' GROUP BY product_code, product_name, unit ORDER BY product_name LIMIT 200

SELECT p.code, p.name, p.unit, SUM(-im.quantity) AS units_shipped FROM copilot.inventory_moves AS im JOIN copilot.products AS p ON p.id = im.product_id WHERE im.move_type = 'SO_SHIPMENT' AND im.move_date >= CURRENT_DATE - 30 AND p.category = 'Pakaian Jadi' AND im.quantity < 0 GROUP BY p.code, p.name, p.unit ORDER BY units_shipped DESC, p.name LIMIT 200
SELECT code, name, balance FROM copilot.gl_accounts WHERE account_type = 'ASSET' AND (name ILIKE '%kas%' OR name ILIKE '%bank%') ORDER BY name LIMIT 200

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(debit - credit), 0) AS electricity_expense_idr FROM copilot.journal_lines WHERE entry_status = 'POSTED' AND entry_date >= CURRENT_DATE - 90 AND account_type = 'EXPENSE' AND (account_name ILIKE '%listrik%' OR account_name ILIKE '%electricity%') LIMIT 200

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN account_type = 'REVENUE' THEN credit - debit ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_revenue_idr, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN account_type = 'EXPENSE' THEN debit - credit ELSE 0 END), 0) AS total_expenses_idr FROM copilot.journal_lines WHERE entry_status = 'POSTED' AND entry_date >= CAST(DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CURRENT_DATE) AS DATE) AND entry_date < CAST((DATE_TRUNC('MONTH', CURRENT_DATE) + INTERVAL '1 MONTH') AS DATE) AND account_type IN ('REVENUE', 'EXPENSE') LIMIT 200

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN account_type = 'REVENUE' THEN credit - debit ELSE 0 END), 0) - COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN account_type = 'EXPENSE' AND (account_name ILIKE '%harga pokok penjualan%' OR account_name ILIKE '%hpp%' OR account_name ILIKE '%cost of goods sold%') THEN debit - credit ELSE 0 END), 0) AS laba_kotor_idr FROM copilot.journal_lines WHERE entry_status = 'POSTED' AND entry_date >= CURRENT_DATE - 90 LIMIT 200
SELECT department, COUNT(*) AS jumlah_karyawan_aktif FROM copilot.employees WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' GROUP BY department ORDER BY department LIMIT 200
SELECT department, COUNT(*) AS late_count FROM copilot.attendance WHERE attendance_date >= CURRENT_DATE - 30 AND is_late = TRUE GROUP BY department ORDER BY late_count DESC, department LIMIT 200

SELECT department, ROUND(CAST(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER(WHERE status = 'PRESENT') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS DECIMAL), 2) AS attendance_rate_pct FROM copilot.attendance WHERE attendance_date >= CURRENT_DATE - 30 AND attendance_date <= CURRENT_DATE GROUP BY department ORDER BY department LIMIT 200
SELECT DISTINCT employee_name, department FROM copilot.attendance WHERE status IN ('SICK', 'LEAVE') AND attendance_date >= CURRENT_DATE - 7 ORDER BY employee_name, department LIMIT 200
